mushroomGrowers.context: The regional specialty mushroom growers is really two separate parts, North and South, that do not affect each other: each has its own growing rooms, rooms under construction, rooms starting up, idle rooms. We are not sure how unevenly the reference demand divides between North and South: it could be as lopsided as 90/10, or close to even, 55/45. The growing rooms divides evenly, and everything else is the same in both.

questions.text: how high the monthly losses (both parts together) will peak, if the reference demand divides 90/10
